title: Lortha Peel
description: Lortha Peel was a water monger in the worker's district of Mos Espa. Because of the troubling times, he raised the price of water exorbitantly, which led some to resort to stealing rations of water. Dissatisfied with this outbreak of theft, he petitioned the new Daimyo, Boba Fett, to step in and handle it, but was dismayed when Boba Fett hired the thieves as muscle instead of punishing them.
